title: [Agent Lab] 3D Multiverse Globe Map
body:
### Task description

The human's idea: "I would like to add 3D multiverse map like Google Earth which I can do zoom in/out and rotate it."\n\nAnswers from the human:\n- The globe is purely visual.\n- Clicking a node opens its detail view and/or adds it to Favorites ("Exactly!").\n- The model is a globe.\n- It replaces the current explorer view.\n- Mouse and touch input are enough.\n\nThe app gets an interactive 3D globe of the multiverse. The user can rotate it and zoom in and out, like Google Earth. It replaces the current explorer view.\n\n**Assumption:** "Purely visual" means there is no new backend or API data. The nodes on the globe come from the data the app already loads (locations and characters from the Rick and Morty API), and clicking a node uses the existing detail modal and Favorites behaviour.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The explorer view is replaced by a 3D globe that renders nodes (assumed: existing locations/characters) on a sphere.\n- [ ] Dragging with the mouse rotates the globe; a one-finger drag rotates it on touch devices.\n- [ ] Mouse wheel zooms in/out; pinch zooms on touch. Zoom is clamped to a minimum and maximum distance.\n- [ ] Clicking/tapping a node opens its existing detail view.\n- [ ] A node's detail view lets the user add it to or remove it from Favorites, using the existing Favorites flow (including the existing sign-in requirement).\n- [ ] A loading state is shown while data loads, and an error state with retry is shown if loading fails. Failures are not silently ignored.\n- [ ] If WebGL is unavailable, a clear message is shown (the human did not ask for a fallback; see notes).\n- [ ] No new backend endpoints or contract changes are required.\n- [ ] Automated frontend tests cover rendering, node selection, and the loading, error and no-WebGL states. Layout logic is unit-tested.\n- [ ] The frontend test suite and production build pass.

### Scope - layers

- [x] Frontend (frontend/)
- [ ] Backend (backend/src/Favorites.Api, .Application, .Domain, .Infrastructure)
- [ ] DevOps / Infra (.github/workflows/, infra/)
